tagline: Score funding opportunities against our strategy.
notes: Copy this file to org_config.json and edit it. org_config.json is git-ignored so your organization's identity does not get committed to the template. brand_color sets the single accent color (progress bars, brand mark, active nav); the rest of the UI follows the warm neutral design system. Your scoring strategy lives in the Strategy Profile, not here (see PROFILE_GUIDE.md).
